fields.assessment_notes: SoCalMagic remains a real Magic-dedicated Orange store with strong inventory, review, and event signals, but the repeated Wizards/EventLink `Commander all day / No proxy` language remains a major personal-fit exclusion. A bounded recheck found no quick mitigating source that narrows the no-proxy rule. Direct Yelp-derived review evidence supports both sides of the read: friendly/mom-and-pop Magic-store positives and Commander house-rule concerns. Keep SoCalMagic cataloged as an important Magic venue, but deprioritized for Kavi's personal Commander planning unless future evidence shows proxy-friendly casual tables or narrows the no-proxy rule to a specific event lane.

fields.assessment_notes: CoreTCG is clearly an active, high-scale Pasadena TCG retailer with substantial Magic product depth, official source routing, a Friday Magic schedule anchor, and a large Discord route. The April 16, 2026 Instagram schedule post shows Friday Magic at 4:30 PM and says the April schedule otherwise stayed the same, which corroborates the existing Friday 4:30 PM Wizards/EventLink Commander row without proving additional MTG formats. Treat CoreTCG as real Magic infrastructure with useful event coverage, but still not a proven casual Bracket 2/3 solo-arrival Commander fit until Discord/LFG texture or in-store experience is reviewed.

fields.assessment_notes: Magic and Monsters remains a real Magic/TCG-focused Mission Viejo candidate with stronger source routing than previously visible: official site, official events page, Instagram, Facebook, Linktree, review surfaces, and a sizable Discord route. The current official calendar is live but complicates the event read because the July 2026 visible slice shows Pokemon, Yu-Gi-Oh!, Vendetta, and Star Wars events, with no MTG/Commander entries in the reviewed week/month. Instagram still supports Magic activity through profile schedule language (`Monday: YGO-MTG`, `Friday: FNM`) and recent Marvel Super Heroes Magic product/prerelease-style promotion, while Wizards/EventLink already supports Friday Commander Free Play. Treat the existing Commander row as represented but needing targeted event replay before relying on Friday FNM/Commander as fully reconciled. Places fit improves because reviews and social routing point to an active, welcoming TCG shop, but distance and event-calendar mismatch keep it in watch/verify rather than try-immediately.
